jobs.title: Vil du kombinere salg, kundekontakt og interesse for lastebilbransjen
jobs.description:
Den beste feilen er den som aldri oppstår. For kundene våre handler en lastebil om langt mer enn transport. Den skal starte hver dag, levere som planlagt og være på veien når kunden trenger den. Når service, kontroller eller nødvendige reparasjoner blir utsatt, kan det raskt føre til driftsstans og unødvendige kostnader.I Norsk Scania ønsker vi å være i forkant. Derfor ser vi nå etter en Account Manager, Rolling Fleet som vil bidra til å utvikle kundeoppfølgingen vår, identifisere nye salgsmuligheter og sørge for at kundene får mest mulig ut av kjøretøyene sine.Dette er en spennende mulighet for deg som trives med kundekontakt, motiveres av salg og liker å finne løsninger som skaper verdi for både kunden og Scania.Om rollenSom Account Manager Rolling Fleet får du en sentral rolle i oppfølgingen av våre eksisterende kunder og deres kjøretøy.Ved hjelp av kunde- og kjøretøydata skal du identifisere behov, se salgsmuligheter og tilby løsninger som bidrar til økt oppetid og en mer effektiv drift for kundene våre.Du vil ha tett dialog med kundene og samarbeide med våre verksteder, kundemottakere og salgsorganisasjonen for å sikre at behov blir fulgt opp og omgjort til konkrete salg og verkstedoppdrag.Dette er en spennende rolle for deg som vil kombinere salg, relasjonsbygging og interesse for transportbransjen.ArbeidsstedStillingen vil ha kontorsted ved et av våre Scania-anlegg på Østlandet. Vi er fleksible når det gjelder lokasjon, og endelig arbeidssted avtales i løpet av rekrutteringsprosessen.Hvem ser vi etter?Vi ser etter deg som trives med kundekontakt, er nysgjerrig på kundens behov og motiveres av å skape resultater.Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:
  • Liker å bruke telefonen som arbeidsverktøy og ta initiativ til kundedialog.
  • Har interesse for lastebiler, transportbransjen og kundens drift.
  • Er god til å bygge relasjoner og skape tillit.
  • Har et kommersielt blikk og ser muligheter for mersalg.
  • Jobber strukturert og samarbeider godt med andre.
  • Har konkurranseinstinkt og motiveres av å nå mål.
Du har gjerne erfaring fra salg, kundeservice, verksted eller transportbransjen. Relevant utdanning er positivt, men ikke avgjørende.For oss er motivasjonen din, evnen til å skape gode kunderelasjoner og viljen til å lære minst like viktig som hva som står på CV-en.Hva kan vi tilby deg?Hos Norsk Scania blir du en del av et solid, internasjonalt selskap med dyktige kolleger og et stort engasjement for både kunder og medarbeidere.Vi tilbyr deg:
  • En spennende og variert rolle med mulighet til å påvirke kundeopplevelsen og salgsresultatene.
  • Muligheten til å bidra til å utvikle vår kundeoppfølging.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og kompetente kolleger.
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.
  • Årlige sosiale sammenkomster og aktiviteter som skaper samhold og trivsel.
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.
Klar for å bli en del av Scania?Vi ser etter deg som ikke bare ser en lastebil, men også mulighetene som ligger i å holde den på veien.Hos oss får du bruke din kommersielle teft, bygge sterke kunderelasjoner og bidra til løsninger som gjør en forskjell for kundene våre.Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad!Har du spørsmål om stillingen, er du velkommen til å kontakte Christoffer Hermann, regionsdirektør for Region Øst Nord, på telefon 993 32 778.Søknadsfrist: Onsdag 9. desember 2026.Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Všeobecná náplň práce je projektovanie protipožiarnej bezpečnosti stavieb (novostavieb, ako aj jestvujúcich stavieb) a technologických zariadení. Miestom výkonu práce je kancelária v Banskej Bystrici.

Návrh optimálneho a ekonomického riešenia protipožiarnej bezpečnosti pre zverené stavby a technologické zariadenia.

- Pri poskytovaní starostlivosti volí najmenšiu potrebnú mieru pomoci; činnosť, ktorú prijímateľ nezvládne ani s primeranou podporou, vykoná v potrebnom rozsahu a prijímateľa pritom zapája podľa jeho možností, rešpektuje jeho tempo, voľbu, súkromie a dôstojnosť.
- Sleduje telesný, psychický a emočný stav prijímateľa a zmeny významné pre poskytovanie starostlivosti; závažné alebo neobvyklé zistenia bezodkladne oznamuje príslušnému odbornému zamestnancovi alebo nadriadenému a zaznamenáva ich podľa interných postupov.

jobs.title: Majstri (supervízori) v priemyselnej výrobe

Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

    Dohľad nad dodržiavaním BOZP, požiarnej ochrany, poriadku na pracovisku a bezpečnej práce so strojmi a zariadeniami.

    Spoluúčasť na plánovaní kapacít, optimalizácii pracovných postupov a zlepšovaní organizácie pracovísk.

jobs.description: Hľadáte prácu, kde sa vaša precíznosť premení na jedinečné módne kúsky? Čo od vás očakávame?•    Vzdelanie alebo prax v odbore (vyučenie v odbore krajčír/ka alebo preukázateľné skúsenosti so šitím).•    Skúsenosť s prácou v módnom ateliéri alebo so zákazkovým šitím (veľkou výhodou).•    Znalosť technológie šitia a ovládanie priemyselných šijacích strojov (overlock,rovnosteh)•    Zmysel pre detail, presnosť a trpezlivosť – každý steh u nás musí byť dokonalý.•    Flexibilita a cit pre estetiku. Čo vám ponúkame?•    Inšpiratívne prostredie moderného a kreatívneho módneho ateliéru.•    Práca na jedinečných projektoch, žiadna stereotypná pásová výroba.•    Prístup k najnovším módnym trendom a exkluzívnym materiálom.•    Flexibilný pracovný čas (podľa dohody).•    Motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie závislé od vašich skúseností a kvality odvedenej práce.•    Zamestnanecká zľava na modely z našej dielne.Miesto výkonu práce: Rimavská SobotaDruh pracovného pomeru: TPP / Skrátený úväzokMzdové podmienky: Dohodou (v závislosti od skúseností)

jobs.title: Čašníci a someliéri
jobs.description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Náplň práce:

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

Reprezentovanie dobrého mena Strachan Resortu úsmevom a proaktívnym prístupom.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Merchant Risk Analyst
jobs.description:
Build with us
Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.
Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.
With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.
We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.
Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

This is a high-impact role where you directly protect Mollie's financial stability and reputation. As an Merchant Risk Analyst, you are the first line of defense, proactively monitoring merchant activity to identify and mitigate patterns indicative of fraud or financial crime. This work is critical to safeguarding our platform integrity, ensuring our merchants and customers can trust Mollie as a secure and reliable payments provider.

You will be expected to conduct proactive and reactive fraud investigations, moving beyond simple alert validation to interpret complex fraud scenarios and uncover emerging risks. Your analysis and recommendations will directly shape cross-team decision-making across compliance, operations, and fraud strategy, positioning you as a trusted Subject Matter Expert.

If you are driven to continuously challenge existing practices, propose improvements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, and want to master the craft of financial crime analysis, you will be key to strengthening our overall risk resilience and staying ahead of evolving threats in the payments landscape.

What you'll ship

  • Detect and investigate fraud risks through proactive monitoring, deep data analysis, and event-driven reviews of merchant activity.

  • Mitigate financial losses by validating, escalating, and actioning fraud alerts promptly to protect platform integrity.

  • Deliver clear, actionable recommendations for mitigation strategies based on your interpretation of complex fraud scenarios and typologies.

  • Drive continuous process improvement by proactively proposing enhancements to our fraud-prevention frameworks, tools, and processes.

  • Serve as a Subject Matter Expert, advising internal and external stakeholders on emerging fraud trends, typologies, and compliance standards.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on experience in fraud detection, investigations, or financial crime analysis.

  • Strong data analysis skills and the proven ability to interpret complex transaction patterns and identify anomalies.

  • Knowledge of payment systems, merchant risk, fraud typologies, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Proficiency with fraud monitoring tools, case management systems, or relevant dashboards.

  • Clear and effective communication skills to articulate complex scenarios and mitigation strategies to cross-functional and external teams.

  • A proactive, detail-oriented approach that thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.

Base location for this role can be either Amsterdam or Maastricht.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Andere legal AI-tools draaien op onze data en software. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen:

  • Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie.

  • Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling.

  • Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken.

  • Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development.

  • Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met je collega HR Adviseurs en de Head of People aan de verdere opbouw van het people team.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een HR professional die begrijpt hoe tech & product teams werken. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie snel groeit en van richting verandert. Je bent niet bang om moeilijke gesprekken te voeren en weet hoe je mensen vooruit helpt zonder ze te verliezen. Je bent praktisch, direct en houdt van een omgeving die nog niet af is.

  • Je hebt minmaal 5 jaar relevante HR-ervaring, bij voorkeur in een tech- of IT-omgeving, en weet hoe je in die context het verschil maakt.

  • Je begrijpt de dynamiek van snelgroeiende teams en bent gewend om managers te adviseren over leiderschap, teamdynamiek en prestatieontwikkeling.

  • Je hebt ervaring met performance management en weet hoe je dat praktisch inricht voor mensen die nooit eerder in een gestructureerde cyclus hebben gewerkt.

  • Je hebt meegebouwd aan een salarishuis of vergelijkbare HR-structuur en snapt hoe je dat bespreekbaar maakt in een organisatie.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met cultuurtrajecten en leiderschapsprogramma's en denkt mee over hoe die eruit moeten zien bij Lefebvre Sdu.

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je komt binnen in een organisatie die hard groeit en volop in beweging is. Het tech, content en IT-team dat jij begeleidt staat middenin die beweging: veertig mensen, tien open stoelen en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR-partner die hen daarin niet volgt, maar voorgaat.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag één invloed hebt op de mensen, de cultuur en de groei van een van de snelst groeiende teams van Lefebvre Sdu.

  • De kans om samen te werken met een nieuw leadership team dat hun baan in big tech bewust inruilde voor de kans om hier iets te bouwen wat er nog niet was.

jobs.title: Retain Young Temporary Workers
jobs.description: And How Can You Retain Young Temporary Workers? 19-10-2026 Written by: Sude Tomak Young employees have become an essential part of the logistics, production and horticulture sectors. Yet many employers find it challenging to retain Gen Z workers. Young people tend to change jobs more frequently and have different expectations of their employers. But does this mean they are less loyal? Not necessarily. Above all, they want clear expectations, to feel valued and to have opportunities to develop their skills. jobs.title: Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."

You will join the Platform & Connectivity team and build alongside its cloud, backend, and DevOps engineers. This is an individual-contributor technical leadership role, not a people-management position — you carry the architectural vision and build it hands-on with the team, rather than designing something for others to execute.

If you'd rather ship a solid, working solution than iterate endlessly toward a theoretically ideal one, and you have a track record of keeping cloud costs under control at scale, you'll thrive in this role.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, you get to know our cloud platform, the device connectivity and the team. You review the current architecture, its costs and its production-readiness, and identify where the biggest risks and quick wins are. You take ownership of the cloud architecture for our first LIS integration, and you agree with the team on the first architectural standards for observability, logging and infrastructure as code.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, our first LIS integration runs reliably in production, with monitoring, alerting and failure handling in place. Cloud costs are predictable and under control, and key architectural decisions and trade-offs are recorded. The team uses shared patterns instead of reinventing solutions, and is confident running production systems as we move from pre-market to post-market.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Set the technical direction for our AWS-based cloud platform and build it hands-on with the team — weighing cost, operability, and production-readiness as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

  • Own the cloud architecture of Vitestro's first LIS integration over the cloud: secure, reliable, and traceable data exchange between our platform and the hospital laboratory

  • Choose solutions on their merits rather than defaulting to the most AWS-native option — including other clouds, self-hosted tooling, or dedicated infrastructure when that's genuinely the better fit

  • Take implementations from a working prototype to something that's production-ready — monitoring, alerting, and failure handling included. You bring experience with production systems and advise the team on how to navigate from pre-market to post-market stages.

  • Establish architectural standards and patterns so similar problems (e.g. observability, logging, data pipelines) get solved consistently instead of reinvented each time

  • Keep cloud costs in check as part of everyday engineering decisions, catching expensive mistakes before they show up on an invoice

  • Balance short-term solutions driven by business needs and deadlines against the long-term architecture: make each trade-off explicit, record it, and plan the path from the tactical fix to the durable solution

  • Diagnose and resolve production issues across the cloud platform from logs, metrics, and traces


What You’ll Bring:

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with AWS at scale — not certification-level familiarity, but real experience with what breaks and what gets expensive as usage grows

  • Proven experience running production systems end to end, from design and release through monitoring and incident response, and the ability to advise a team that is new to production

  • Genuine experience building outside an AWS-only mindset — another cloud, self-hosted/open-source alternatives, or dedicated/on-premise infrastructure — enough to make an informed trade-off, not just AWS as the only tool you reach for

  • A track record of finishing what others started: turning a partial or unstable implementation into something genuinely reliable in production

  • Strong Infrastructure as Code practice (Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) as the authoritative source of environment configuration

  • Comfortable operating in a regulated, security-conscious environment where architecture decisions have compliance implications

  • Familiarity with AWS cost structure, along with the ability to factor in cost-related considerations when designing infrastructure

  • Professional English; Dutch is a plus

Nice to have:

  • Experience specifically with observability/logging platforms at scale (e.g. OpenSearch, Grafana/Loki stacks, or equivalent) — bringing an implementation to production-hardened state, not just standing it up

  • Experience in medical device, healthcare, or another regulated industry

  • Familiarity with multi-tenant, per-customer cloud architectures (e.g. isolated accounts or workloads per client/region)

  • Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including a pension plan

  • 25 days of annual leave (full-time position)

  • A high-skilled team based in Utrecht

  • Frequent out-of-work team activities and an annual company weekend away

  • A training budget

  • The chance to help shape the new niche of autonomous medical robotics

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. We offer a learning environment where we grow together!

jobs.title: Postdoc (f_m_x) – Hydraulic Stimulation for Enhanced Geothermal Systems (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For the EU-funded project UPLIFT in section4.3 Geoenergy (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/geoenergy/overview) (department 'Geosystems (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) '), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) – Geothermal Reservoir StimulationReference Number 11660UPLIFT (https://uplift-horizon.eu/) brings together key European Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS (https://www.geothermie.de/bibliothek/lexikon-der-geothermie/e/egs) ) industry and research institutions to demonstrate, at Czechia's leading energy research site RINGEN, how water-only multi-stage hydraulic shear stimulation treatments can be efficiently implemented in metamorphic basement rocks in Europe, while reducing technical, social, and environmental risks.A central focus is the development and application of adaptive stimulation designs that use real-time seismic and hydraulic data to improve treatment efficiency and safety. The project will also investigate micro-turbine drilling as an alternative to conventional perforation techniques to improve reservoir access. Laboratory experiments will assess the self-propping behaviour of European basement rocks and benchmark their stimulation response against acid- and proppant-based methods. Water-only and proppant-based stimulation treatments will also be compared at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory. In parallel, the project will develop high-fidelity, physics-based digital twins to guide stimulation design, alongside fast surrogate models to support real-time operational decision-making. The stimulation activities are supported by high-resolution, real-time seismic monitoring, conventional and adaptive traffic light systems, and social science research.As a postdoctoral researcher, you will play a central role in planning, supervising and analysing the adaptive multi-stage hydraulic stimulation treatments at the RINGEN EGS site in Litoměřice, Czechia. This position offers the opportunity to connect advanced research with field operations and contribute directly to developing efficient, safe geothermal stimulation technologies.Your responsibilities:- Co-lead the hydraulic stimulation and well test activities at the Litoměřice EGS site- Analyse stimulation and well test data to compare and understand the hydraulic and seismic response of metamorphic basement rock to different stimulation methods and injection protocols, including adaptive injection strategies- Contribute to detailed operational planning and the preparation of tender documents- Contribute to the techno-economic assessment of different stimulation methods and their implications for EGS development- Publish your findings in peer-reviewed journals and communicate them at scientific conferences and to non-scientific stakeholdersAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (or equivalent) and a PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in reservoir/petroleum engineering, drilling/completion engineering, geophysics, geothermal energy, applied geosciences, or equivalent- Research or industry background in Enhanced Geothermal Systems, well stimulation or induced seismicity- Well test analysis- Proficiency in spoken and written EnglishDesirable Qualifications:- German or Czech language skills are useful, but not required- Strong motivation and creativity, combined with an independent, structured, reliable and results-oriented working attitude- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with interdisciplinary project partners, the scientific community, engineers, and non-technical stakeholdersStart date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Vollzeit (derzeit 39 h/Woche); die Stelle ist grundsätzlich teilzeitgeeignet.Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment- State-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on site- Working at the Albert Einstein Science Park on the Telegrafenberg in Potsdam- Workplace within walking distance of Potsdam main train station, or just a short ride on the shuttle busHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 13th December 2026. Please use our online application form only.Required documents: letter of motivation, CV, grades/certificatesThe GFZ actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities. We explicitly welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic and social origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation and identity, religion/belief, age, and physical or neurodiverse abilities.“Diversity in perspectives” is one of GFZ's core values. As an integral part of supporting diversity at our centre, we actively promote women in science and in leadership positions. To know more about our Diversity policies, contact the diversity team. If you need more information about our gender equality policies, please do not hesitate to contact our Equal Opportunities Officer (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/employee-representation) and check our Equal Opportunities Plan & Cascade Model (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/the-gfz-as-an-employer/equal-opportunities) .We look forward to applications from people who enjoy working in diverse teams, where everyone feels respected and valued and can fully develop their own talents. Applicants with severe disabilities and equalised persons will receive preferential consideration if equally qualified.Data protection information for applicants (https://www.gfz.de/en/career/job-offers#c95430)In case of any further queries regarding the field of activity, please contact Prof. Dr. Hannes Hofmann (hannes.hofmann@gfz.de) via email. If you have any general questions about the application process, please contact our recruiting team at our phone number +49 (0) 331-6264-28787.

jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d) (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
jobs.description: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus)You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.Why join us?- Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.- Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.- International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.- Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.- Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.About us – in briefHeadquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.Your Role – What You'll OwnYou will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.Your Responsibilities- Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.- Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need.- Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites.- Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.- Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs.- Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues.- Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities.- Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned.What You BringWe are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations.Must-have – Essential RequirementsThe following skills and experience are essential for this position:Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure- Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage.- Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure.- Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management.Infrastructure Modernization- A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems.- Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations.- Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments.Identity & Access Management- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments.- Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls.Endpoint Management- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment.Resilience, Security & Monitoring- Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor.- Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation.Communication & Collaboration- Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations.- Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders.- Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage.- Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations.Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered.Nice-to-have – Additional ExperienceThe following skills are beneficial but not essential:- Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects.- Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods.- Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management.- Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers.- Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel.- Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub.- Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform.- Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP.- Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300.Your First 12 MonthsYour initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure:- Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure.- Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt.- Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required.- Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune.- Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency.- Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery.- Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.What We Offer- Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site.- Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience.- Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security.- Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.- Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices.- Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group.Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus)Start date: As soon as possible⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-timeReady to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure?We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements.Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team.We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)  in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic MonitoringSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of Genomic Biomonitoring at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01.02.2027:**Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring ****(Full-Time / Part-Time)**Location: FrankfurtEmployment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.Genetic diversity is a fundamental component of biodiversity, providing the evolutionary potential that allows species and populations to adapt to environmental change. Yet genetic diversity is declining and remains comparatively underrepresented in biodiversity monitoring and policy. At the Genomic Biomonitoring Lab at Senckenberg, we work to address that gap and are seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join us in that aim.The position will focus on how genetic diversity can be measured, monitored and incorporated into practical conservation. This spans from species-level applications to national and international biodiversity policy. The researcher will contribute to ongoing projects on endangered and threatened species where genomics is needed to support management or can be used for monitoring. At the international scale, there is scope to investigate how genetic diversity can be incorporated into global biodiversity frameworks and assessments.We are looking for a researcher who is excited to help shape this emerging research area. The postdoctoral researcher will have the opportunity to develop new research questions and projects under our shared research programme. We are particularly interested in candidates who combine deep scientific curiosity with a motivation to translate ideas into practical conservation impact. Experience working in conservation genetics or genomics is thus essential.Your tasks- Conduct high-quality research on conservation genomics, genetic monitoring and integration of genetic diversity into policy.- Develop and apply approaches for monitoring and protecting genetic diversity in wild populations in Germany and at focal international sites.- Work on connecting genetic diversity with national and international policy.- Collaborate with researchers, conservation organisations, and other stakeholders.- Publish findings in high-quality peer-reviewed journals and present results at international conferences.- Communicate research findings to non-academic audiences, including through policy briefs and communication with conservation managers, and policymakers.- Supervise BSc and/or MSc thesis students.- Help develop international funding proposals for genetic diversity protection and monitoring.Your profile- A PhD in population/conservation/evolutionary genomics or a related field.- At least one year of postdoctoral research experience.- Hands-on experience with genomic datasets.- Experience in conservation biology and biodiversity protection, including collaboration with conservation practitioners, managers, or policy makers.- A strong publication record appropriate to your career stage.Desirable skills- Excellent scientific writing and communication skills in English.- Experience or a strong interest in developing research proposals and securing third-party funding.- A collaborative, collegial and well-organised approach to research and teamwork.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Senckenberg is certified under the audit berufundfamilie programme and is committed to promoting a better work-life balance.How to apply?Please upload your applicationelectronically as a single PDF by 05.12.2026, containing:- A letter of motivation (1-2 pages), including clear explanations about your interest in the position and an outline of how your experience fits the research programme.- CV and publication list.- PhD certificate.- Contact details for two academic refereesPlease upload your application by clicking on the "Apply Online" button in the bottom of this announcement. Applications via email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Deborah Leighat deborah.leigh@senckenberg.de

jobs.title: Network Engineer / IT-Netzwerkspezialist (m/w/d) – WAN & Standortvernetzung (Netzwerkadministrator/in)
jobs.description: Du sorgst dafür, dass Unternehmen verbunden bleiben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass du den passenden Job findest.Ein Netzwerk ist für dich mehr als ein paar Switches, Router und blinkende LEDs? Du weißt, wie man Standorte zuverlässig miteinander verbindet, Netzwerkstrukturen optimiert und auch bei komplexen Herausforderungen den Überblick behält?Dann könnte diese Position genau dein nächster Karriereschritt sein!Für ein etabliertes, deutschlandweit tätiges Unternehmen mit einer vielseitigen IT-Landschaft suchen wir einen Network Engineer / IT-Netzwerkspezialisten (m/w/d), der die standortübergreifende Netzwerkinfrastruktur aktiv mitgestaltet und weiterentwickelt.Dich erwartet eine spannende Mischung aus Netzwerktechnik, modernen WAN-Technologien, Projektarbeit und der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Providern.Deine Aufgaben - Hier kommt dein Netzwerk-Know-how ins Spiel- Standorte verbinden: Du planst und realisierst WAN-Anbindungen für neue und bestehende Unternehmensstandorte und begleitest die Umsetzung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme.- Netzwerke weiterentwickeln: Du sorgst für eine stabile, sichere und leistungsfähige Vernetzung der Standorte und optimierst bestehende Netzwerkstrukturen.- Den gesamten Lifecycle begleiten: Ob neue Standorte, Erweiterungen, Bandbreiten-Upgrades, Providerwechsel oder Standortumzüge - du koordinierst die technischen Maßnahmen.- Provider steuern: Du bist technischer Ansprechpartner für Telekommunikationsanbieter und externe IT-Dienstleister und begleitest die Bereitstellung neuer Verbindungen.- Technologien einsetzen: Du arbeitest mit modernen Netzwerkarchitekturen und Technologien wie WAN, LAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Routing und Switching.- Projekte vorantreiben: Du unterstützt bei Infrastrukturprojekten, entwickelst technische Standards weiter und bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung ein.- Qualität sicherstellen: Du prüfst neue Standortanbindungen, begleitest technische Abnahmen und sorgst für eine reibungslose Übergabe in den produktiven Betrieb.Dein Profil - Das bringst du mit- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, ein IT-Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Netzwerkadministration oder im Bereich IT-Netzwerkinfrastruktur.- Fundierte Kenntnisse in WAN, LAN, WLAN, Routing, Switching, TCP/IP und VLAN.- Kenntnisse im Bereich SD-WAN und moderner Standortvernetzung.- Idealerweise hast du bereits Unternehmensstandorte angebunden und mit Telekommunikationsprovidern zusammengearbeitet.- Du gehst technische Herausforderungen strukturiert an und findest auch bei komplexeren Netzwerkproblemen passende Lösungen.- Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich, kommunizierst sicher und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.- Führerschein der Klasse B sowie die Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen.Wichtig: Du musst nicht jede Technologie bis ins kleinste Detail beherrschen. Entscheidend sind deine fundierten Netzwerkkenntnisse, praktische Erfahrung und die Motivation, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.Deine Benefits - Das erwartet dich- Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Unbefristete Festanstellung in einer wirtschaftlich breit aufgestellten Unternehmensgruppe.- Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation passt.- Spannende IT-Projekte: Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einer standortübergreifenden IT-Infrastruktur.- Weiterbildung: Umfangreiche Qualifizierungsangebote und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.- Strukturierte Einarbeitung: Ein persönlicher Ansprechpartner und ein durchdachter Einarbeitungsplan erleichtern dir den Einstieg.- Gesundheitsförderung: Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement und weitere Angebote.- Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket sowie attraktive Fahrrad- und PKW-Leasingangebote.- Mitarbeitervorteile: Corporate Benefits, Mobilfunk- und DSL-Vergünstigungen sowie attraktive Hotelrabatte.- Teamkultur: Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld, gemeinsame Veranstaltungen und regelmäßige Teamevents.Klingt nach deinem nächsten Netzwerkprojekt?IHR ANSPRECHPARTNERFühlen Sie sich angesprochen?Dann senden Sie uns Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (in einer PDF-Datei) an Christian Peters christian.peters@griepenstroh.com oder über unsere Connect-Plattform. Wir bitten um die Angabe Ihres möglichen Beginns und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellungen.Ist diese Stelle nichts für Sie? Dann vernetzen Sie sich gerne mit uns über unsere Connect-Plattform, sodass Sie immer über unsere aktuellen Vakanzen auf dem Laufenden gehalten werden können.

jobs.title: Rezeptionist/in auf Burg Breuberg (m/w/d) (Empfangskraft)

Rabatte (Sportartikel, Sprachreisen, Busreisen)- 50% Übernachtungsrabatt in den Jugendherbergen in Hessen- Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote- Coole Mitarbeitenden-Bekleidung- Corporate Benefits- Team-EventsDas bringst du mit- Du kannst dich schnell in neue Abläufe und Aufgabengebiete einarbeiten- PC- Kenntnisse (Microsoft Office)- Du bist flexibel, selbst organisiert, kreativ und arbeitest eigenverantwortlich- Durch deinen ausgeprägten Servicegedanken fühlen sich unsere Gäste bei dir wohl und willkommen- Du verfügst über fließende Deutschkenntnisse- Du bist mobil und verfügst über einen eigenen, fahrbaren Untersatz (PKW, Roller etc.), da die Anreise zur Burg nicht per ÖPNV oder zu Fuß möglich ist- Ein respektvolles Miteinander ist dir wichtig- Du trittst sauber, gepflegt und vorbildlich aufWer wir sindIn unseren 28 Jugendherbergen schaffen wir Orte, an denen echte Erlebnisse entstehen. jobs.title: Teamleiter Kundenservice in Portugal | Hybrid (Callcenteragent/in)
jobs.description: Für einen international bekannten Konzern suchen wir einen deutschsprachigen Teamleiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Customer Experience / Consumer Engagement  in Lissabon oder Braga. In dieser Position übernimmst du Verantwortung für ein Kundenservice-Team, entwickelst deine Mitarbeitenden weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Servicequalität, Teamperformance und Kundenzufriedenheit stimmen. Dabei geht es um mehr als die täglichen KPIs: Du bist Ansprechpartner für dein Team, triffst Entscheidungen, setzt Verbesserungen um und arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen. Das erwartet dich: Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit nur zwei Bürotagen pro Woche, geregelte Arbeitszeiten von Montag bis Freitag und ein attraktives Gehaltspaket.Dein neuer Job auf einen BlickPosition:  Teamleiter Kundenservice / CES Supervisor (m/w/d)  Standort:  Lissabon oder Braga, Portugal  Arbeitsmodell:  Hybrid – 2 Tage pro Woche im Büro, die restlichen Tage im Homeoffice ️ Sprache:  Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau  Gehalt:  2.240 € brutto pro Monat / 31.360 € brutto pro Jahr  Bonus:  Zusätzlich bis zu 10 % des Jahresbruttogehalts als Performance-Bonus  Vertrag:  Zunächst auf 12 Monate befristet  Arbeitszeiten:  Montag bis Freitag, wahlweise 08:00–17:00 Uhr oder 09:00–18:00 Uhr  Start:  SchnellstmöglichDeine AufgabenAls Teamleiter im Bereich Consumer Engagement Services bist du für die operative Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung deines Kundenservice-Teams verantwortlich.- Teamführung & Coaching:  Du führst, motivierst und entwickelst deine Mitarbeitenden durch regelmäßiges Feedback, Coaching und individuelle Unterstützung.- Performance Management:  Du analysierst wichtige Kennzahlen wie Service Level, Produktivität, Kundenzufriedenheit und Servicequalität und leitest passende Maßnahmen ab.- Operative Steuerung:  Du koordinierst die täglichen Aufgaben, planst Ressourcen und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe.- Mitarbeiterentwicklung:  Du führst Performance-Gespräche, unterstützt beim Onboarding neuer Mitarbeitender und begleitest dein Team bei Herausforderungen.- Stakeholder Management:  Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Abteilungen und Führungskräften zusammen, stimmst Prioritäten ab und kommunizierst Entscheidungen klar und professionell.- Prozessoptimierung:  Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt Maßnahmen um, um die Effizienz und Qualität im Kundenservice kontinuierlich zu steigern.Das bringst du mitDeutsch:  Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und kannst auch anspruchsvolle Mitarbeiter- und Geschäftsgespräche souverän führen.  Führungserfahrung:  Du hast bereits erfolgreich ein Team geführt und Erfahrung mit Coaching, Mitarbeiterentwicklung und Performance Management gesammelt.  Customer Service Background:  Du kennst die Abläufe im Kundenservice, idealerweise aus einem Contact Center, BPO-Unternehmen oder einer Consumer-Engagement-Abteilung.  KPI-Verständnis:  Du kannst mit Kennzahlen arbeiten, Ergebnisse analysieren und konkrete Maßnahmen zur Verbesserung der Teamleistung entwickeln.  Kommunikationsstärke:  Du kannst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenbringen, konstruktives Feedback geben und auch schwierige Gespräche professionell führen.  Entscheidungsfreude:  Du übernimmst Verantwortung, setzt klare Erwartungen und scheust dich nicht davor, notwendige Entscheidungen zu treffen.  Hands-on-Mentalität:  Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und möchtest gemeinsam mit deinem Team etwas bewegen.  Technisches Verständnis:  Idealerweise hast du bereits mit CRM-Systemen, Helpdesk-Tools oder vergleichbaren Kundenservice-Plattformen gearbeitet. Wichtig: Es gibt keine festgelegte Mindestanzahl an Führungsjahren. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereits echte Personalverantwortung übernommen hast und deine Führungserfahrung anhand konkreter Beispiele zeigen kannst.Deine BenefitsHybrid Work:  Arbeite drei Tage pro Woche bequem von zu Hause und verbringe nur zwei Tage im Büro in Lissabon oder Braga.  Attraktives Gehalt:  2.240 € brutto monatlich beziehungsweise 31.360 € brutto jährlich.  Performance-Bonus:  Zusätzlich besteht die Möglichkeit auf einen Bonus von 10 % deines Jahresbruttogehalts – das entspricht bis zu 3.136 € pro Jahr.  Flexible Benefits:  Ein zusätzliches Benefits-Budget in Höhe von 3 % deines Jahresbruttogehalts. ️ Essenszuschuss:  8,25 € Meal Allowance pro Arbeitstag. ️ Mitarbeiterrabatte:  Profitiere von exklusiven Vergünstigungen im Mitarbeitershop.  Geregelte Arbeitszeiten:  Montag bis Freitag mit zwei möglichen Arbeitszeitmodellen – ohne reguläre Wochenend- oder Nachtschichten.  Internationales Arbeitsumfeld:  Sammle wertvolle Führungserfahrung in einem weltweit tätigen Konzern und arbeite mit unterschiedlichen Teams und Abteilungen zusammen.  Zwei mögliche Standorte:  Entscheide dich für Lissabon oder Braga als deinen Arbeitsstandort.So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess ab1️⃣ Erstes Kennenlernen mit Job Traveler  – Wir sprechen über deine bisherige Führungserfahrung, deine Motivation und die Rahmenbedingungen. 2️⃣ Interview mit deinem zukünftigen Arbeitgeber  – Du lernst das Recruiting-Team und die zuständige Führungskraft kennen. 3️⃣ Online-Assessment  – Du absolvierst ein Online-Assessment im Rahmen des Auswahlprozesses. 4️⃣ Abschlussinterview  – In einem weiteren Gespräch lernst du die verantwortlichen Ansprechpartner des betreuten Marktes kennen. 5️⃣ Feedback & Jobangebot  – Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss erhältst du dein Vertragsangebot.Bereit, ein Team zum Erfolg zu führen?Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Teamleiter, Supervisor oder in einer vergleichbaren Führungsposition gesammelt und möchtest deine Fähigkeiten in einem internationalen Unternehmen einbringen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! Bewirb dich jetzt und starte als deutschsprachiger Teamleiter in Portugal durch!

Mit über 800 Mitarbeiter:innen weltweit (Österreich, Deutschland, USA, Mexiko und China) gestalten wir industrielle Fertigung auf höchstem Niveau.Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams und den deutlich raschen wachsenden Bedarf unserer Life Science (Biotech) Division voranzutreiben suchen wir eine:n erfahrene:n engagierte:n Projekteinkäufer:in für unseren Standort in Ebbs (bei Kufstein).Deine Kernaufgaben:● Projekteinkauf: Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung und Entwicklung des Projekteinkaufs im Bereich Sondermaschinenbau mit klarem Fokus auf die LifeScience & Pharma-Branche.● Beschaffungsstrategien: Durchführung weltweiter Marktanalysen sowie Entwicklung und Umsetzung nachhaltiger Beschaffungsstrategien für Neulieferanten.● Lieferantenmanagement: Qualifizierung neuer Lieferanten und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung bestehender Lieferantenbeziehungen unter Einhaltung der spezifischen Anforderungen des Sondermaschinenbaus und der Pharmabranche.● Vertragsverhandlungen: Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Verhandlungen sowie Abschluss von Rahmen- und Projektverträgen unter Berücksichtigung von Kosten, Qualität und Termintreue.● Materialversorgung & Performance: Sicherstellung der fristgerechten Materialversorgung im Projektverlauf sowie kontinuierliche Überwachung der Lieferantenperformance.● Qualitäts- & Reklamationsmanagement: Enge Schnittstellenarbeit mit den Fachabteilungen zur Bearbeitung und nachhaltigen Lösung von Qualitätsthemen und Reklamationen.Dein Profil:● Ausbildung: Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare fundierte Qualifikation.● Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekteinkauf, idealerweise in der LifeScience-, Pharma-Branche und/oder im hochkomplexen Sondermaschinenbau.● Fachwissen: Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Neulieferantenentwicklung, Lieferantenqualifizierung und Bewertung im Kontext des Anlagen- und Sondermaschinenbaus.● Qualitätsverständnis: Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Qualitätsthemen und Reklamationsprozessen.● Kompetenzen: Hervorragende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten, analytische Denkweise sowie ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz.● Sprachen: Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.Wir bieten Dir:● Anspruchsvolle Aufgaben im internationalen Umfeld mit flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen.● Hochmoderne Arbeitsplätze, die nach neuesten ergonomischen Kriterien optimiert sind.● Individuelle Entwicklungswege durch vielfältige interne und externe Weiterbildungen.● Hauseigenes 3CON Health Center mit Betriebsarzt, Sportangebot und geförderten Heilmassagen (50 % Kostenübernahme).● Erstklassiges Betriebsrestaurant mit frisch zubereiteten, regionalen Menüs zu Vorzugspreisen.● Gelebter Teamgeist durch regelmäßige Sport-, Teambuilding- und Social-Events.● Exklusive Mitarbeitervorteile (u. a. Vergünstigungen bei Partnerfirmen wie Hagebau oder dem Inntaler Logistik-Park).Leistung, die sich lohnt:● Die Entlohnung richtet sich nach dem Kollektivvertrag für das Metallgewerbe. Da wir Spitzenleistungen auch hoch ansetzen, bringen wir eine ausdrückliche Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung mit – dein tatsächliches Gehalt vereinbaren wir individuell basierend auf deiner Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung.Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns, dich kennenzulernen.

jobs.title: Volljurist M&A  (m/w/d) (Jurist/in)
jobs.description: Unser Mandant European Energy ist ein privat geführtes, international stark wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien. Seit 2004 entwickelt, realisiert, betreibt und veräußert das dänische Unternehmen Wind- und Photovoltaikprojekte und treibt mit zukunftsweisenden Lösungen wie Power-to-X die Energieversorgung von morgen voran.Mehr als 800 Mitarbeitende aus 44 Nationalitäten in 21 Ländern arbeiten an der gemeinsamen Vision, einen maßgeblichen Beitrag zur globalen Transformation hin zu einer fossilfreien Zukunft zu leisten.Die international aufgestellte Rechtsabteilung umfasst 17 Juristinnen und Juristen mit Expertise unter anderem im Gesellschafts-, Bau- und Immobilienrecht, M&A, bei Finanzierungstransaktionen sowie im Wirtschafts- und Vertragsrecht. B. jobs.description: Was Dich erwartetMöchtest du dazu beitragen, eine Welt mit nachhaltigem Wohlstand zu schaffen?Bei Tesla ist das unsere Mission! Bewirb dich jetzt als KFZ-Techniker/ KFZ-Mechatroniker (m/w/d) in Wien. Bei Tesla sind unsere Techniker/innen das Rückgrat des Servicebetriebs und unterstützen unsere Mission, den weltweiten Übergang zu nachhaltiger Energie zu beschleunigen. Wir haben eines der innovativsten Fahrzeuge aller Zeiten entwickelt und als Techniker/in trägst du dazu bei, unseren Kunden einen ebenso innovativen Service zu bieten.Wir bieten- Onboarding / Einschulung: Zentralisiertes Onboarding in Berlin für unsere Service Technicians (m/w/d) in EMEA- Karriereentwicklung und Weiterbildung: Bei Tesla hast du die Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung durch regelmäßige Performance Reviews, gezielte Trainingsmaßnahmen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten (z.B. jobs.title: Project Engineer, Electrical Systems
jobs.description:
For our client, we are looking for a Project Engineer to join a highly skilled engineering team working with advanced power generation and energy solutions. This role focuses on generator protection and excitation systems, offering an excellent opportunity to build expertise in a specialized and growing area of the energy sector.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

You will participate in customer projects throughout their lifecycle, from engineering and system configuration to testing and commissioning. Working alongside experienced specialists, you will gradually take on broader technical responsibility and contribute to developing customer-specific solutions.

The position offers a combination of office-based engineering work and practical field activities at customer sites. As your expertise grows, you will also support technical discussions with customers and contribute to solution development activities.

Key Responsibilities:
· Engineering, configuration, and documentation of generator protection and excitation systems.
· Supporting testing, factory acceptance testing (FAT), installation, and commissioning activities.
· Participating in commissioning assignments and technical troubleshooting at customer sites.
· Collaborating closely with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and customers to deliver high-quality technical solutions.
· Providing technical input for solution design and supporting sales and customer-facing activities when needed.

Requirements:
- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Engineering, or a related field
- Experience in electrical engineering, power generation, industrial automation, commissioning, or similar technical environments
- Good understanding of electrical power systems and interest in energy production technologies
- Experience with engineering, configuration, testing, or commissioning activities
- Knowledge of generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or power plant environments is considered an advantage
- Familiarity with electrical design tools is beneficial
- Strong communication and teamwork skills with a proactive, customer-oriented mindset
- Willingness to travel approximately 30 days per year, mainly within Finland and Northern Europe

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical, Automation or Power Engineering?*
- Do you have 2+ years of hands-on experience with electrical engineering, power systems, industrial automation, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you worked with generator protection systems, protection relays, excitation systems, or similar technologies?

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Vaasa (hybrid, minimum 1 day/week onsite)
Start: January 2027
Duration: Long-term assignment (12-month contracts, expected to continue for several years)
Allocation: 100 %
Languages: Fluent Finnish and English; Swedish is a plus

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. jobs.description:
For our client were looking for a Senior Process Integration Engineer / Heat Recovery Specialist.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

The clients product portfolio is expanding, and they are looking for an experienced senior specialist to strengthen the development of heat pump and heat recovery solutions and the design of integrations in an industrial environment. The role is part of an international team of experts. They are not looking for a traditional process engineer, but an experienced integration designer who understands the complete process and piping system built around an industrial heat pump and has a hands-on approach to taking technology from concept to implementation.

Responsibilities:
 Design and implement integration solutions related to industrial heat pumps.
 Develop industrial heat recovery solutions and assess how recovered heat can be used efficiently.
 Design solutions where recovered energy is converted back into useful use.
 Define the technical integrations of heat pump systems, including pump and process solutions.
 Take responsibility for piping design and plant and factory design tasks.
 Produce and maintain process and P&ID diagrams and ensure compliance with standards.
 Take part in defining technical solutions together with the client and the project team.

Requirements:
 Strong experience in industrial processes, energy or heat pump solutions.
 Experience in heat recovery, steam systems or the paper and process industry.
 Skills in piping design and plant or factory design.
 Hands-on experience with the E3D design tool.
 Ability to prepare and interpret process diagrams (PFD, P&ID) and work according to industry standards.
 Experience in the technical integration of different systems and equipment.
 Experience in heat and steam systems of paper machines
 Insight into utilizing industrial waste heat and recycling energy
 Ability to see whole plant and process integrations rather than individual pieces of equipment
 Hands-on approach to taking technology from concept to implementation

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have hands-on experience designing industrial heat pump or heat recovery integrations, ideally in steam systems or the paper and process industry?*
- Have you designed the complete process and piping system around an industrial heat pump or similar installation, rather than only individual equipment or process calculations?*
- Have you taken a technical solution from concept to implementation in an industrial plant?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with E3D and with producing P&ID diagrams?*
- Are you able to work on-site in Raisio or Tikkurila? *

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Start: ASAP
Location: Raisio or Tikkurila (onsite)
Language: Finnish and/or English
Contract length: TBC (To Be Confirmed)

jobs.description:
Were seeking a Senior IT Architect / Strategic Advisor for our client.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Background:
Our client is planning a modernization of its production data and industrial IT architecture. The current environment consists of multiple systems, some of which are approaching end-of-life and require replacement or consolidation. The client has already reviewed several vendor solutions and is now looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to act as an independent, neutral advisor and sparring partner during the assessment and design phase. The consultant will help evaluate the current landscape, identify key challenges and opportunities, and support decision-making regarding future architecture, technology choices, and vendor ecosystem. The objective is a more standardized and controlled architecture that supports operational efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and future AI capabilities.

Responsibilities:
· Assess the current application and architecture landscape.
· Provide independent recommendations on future-state architecture and modernization options.
· Support decision-making related to technology platforms, vendors, and long-term architecture direction.
· Help define the problems to be solved and what the new architecture needs to achieve.
· Facilitate architecture discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
· Help define architectural principles, priorities, and transformation roadmap.
· Identify opportunities to improve data utilization and prepare the environment for future AI-driven initiatives.
· Bring lessons learned from similar industrial transformation programs.

Requirements:
· Experience with production data and industrial IT architecture.
· Experience as a strategic advisor or sparring partner to senior decision-makers, including evaluating technology and vendor options neutrally and challenging proposals.
· Proven track record in large-scale industrial, energy, oil & gas, or process industry environments, with references from similar projects.
