jobs.title: CX Systems & Automation Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our CX Systems & Automation Lead, you'll own the systems that power Notion's global support organization. Reporting to the Head of AMER & EMEA Direct Support, you'll administer and evolve our CX tools (Zendesk, Decagon, and Assembled) as Notion scales, and help decide what our stack looks like next. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll work closely with CX leadership to shape our systems strategy, then design, build, and ship it yourself.



This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own administration and architecture of our Helpdesk and CX platforms, design and build routing, automations, macros, SLAs, permissions, customizations, and third-party integrations, and set best practices for how they're used

 - Partner with CX leadership to shape our CX systems strategy and roadmap, then lead delivery from design through implementation, including running system RFPs when needed and advising on the impact of changes on teams, workflows, and customers

 - Partner with our AI team to configure, maintain, and improve our AI support agents, including knowledge inputs, guardrails, and performance tracking, and help CX leaders decide where automation should and shouldn't handle customer conversations

 - Own change management for CX systems, from prioritizing requests to sandbox testing, release planning, access controls, data privacy (e.g., GDPR, PII handling), and communicating changes to global teams

 - Partner with our global (AMER, EMEA, APAC, & Vendor) CX team to be the point of contact for our CX tool stack

 - Partner with CX leaders to drive tool-related reporting and data visibility

 - Identify, diagnose, and resolve issues that arise with CX tooling systems

 - Maintain up-to-date documentation for our CX tools, including key decisions, major changes, and the business reasons behind routing and automation choices




SKILLS YOU'LL BRING

 - You have 7+ years of relevant experience, ideally in SaaS or AI, with deep hands-on administration of an enterprise helpdesk or CRM (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Fin); experience running or migrating between platforms is a plus

 - You're comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and SQL, have built custom integrations, and have partnered with technical teams to deploy AI agents in a support environment; scripting (JavaScript or Python) or integration tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier) are a plus

 - You're as comfortable in a strategy discussion as in the admin console, and you've personally built the configurations and integrations you've recommended

 - You have experience supporting cross-functional programs that relate to CX, operations, engineering, and enablement

 - You can translate business needs and strategy into technical deliverables and clear roadmaps, and keep leaders and stakeholders aligned on status, milestones, and risks

 - You have a metrics mindset: you measure success by outcomes and have built dashboards that tell a clear story with KPIs

 - You have a scaled approach to tool management & implementation

 - You thrive in ambiguity and can manage technical and administrative work independently as priorities change



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $179,000 - $200,000 per year.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Customs
Junior Product Manager
jobs.description:
Introductie

Ben jij analytisch sterk, commercieel ingesteld en heb je affiniteit met techniek en productmanagement? Weet jij marktontwikkelingen te vertalen naar kansen voor producten en diensten? En krijg jij energie van het optimaliseren van een productportfolio en het succesvol introduceren van nieuwe producten?

Bij FAAC Technologies zoeken we een Junior Product Manager die verantwoordelijk wordt voor de positionering en ontwikkeling van ons productportfolio. In deze rol vorm je de verbindende schakel tussen Sales, Marketing, Techniek en de internationale productmanagementteams van FAAC Group. Door marktontwikkelingen te volgen en klantbehoeften te analyseren, zorg je ervoor dat onze producten aansluiten op de behoeften van de markt en de strategische doelstellingen van de organisatie.

We zoeken iemand die aan het begin van zijn of haar carrière staat en zich verder wil ontwikkelen binnen productmanagement. Of je nu net bent afgestudeerd en klaar bent voor een eerste uitdaging, of al circa 1 tot 3 jaar werkervaring hebt opgedaan: enthousiasme, analytisch vermogen, commerciële interesse en de motivatie om je te ontwikkelen vinden we minstens zo belangrijk als ruime werkervaring.

In deze veelzijdige hybride functie komen marktinzichten, commerciële analyses en technische kennis samen om onze producten en diensten continu te verbeteren. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis en ervaring verder uit te bouwen en te groeien in de rol. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Manager Techniek.

Wat ga je doen / Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Als Product Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de positionering, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van het productportfolio van FAAC Technologies. Marktbehoeften en productontwikkelingen vertaal je naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat productinformatie, prijzen en communicatie actueel en consistent blijven.

  • Analyseren van marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften om deze te vertalen naar het productaanbod

  • Uitvoeren van prijsanalyses en afstemmen van de prijspositionering met internationale productafdelingen

  • Volgen van productontwikkelingen en vertalen van relevante innovaties naar kansen voor de organisatie

  • Afstemmen van productintroducties en de lancering van nieuwe diensten met betrokken teams binnen FAAC Group

  • Begeleiden van processen rondom productintroducties en het uitfaseren van producten

  • Analyseren en optimaliseren van het bestaande productportfolio

  • Coördineren van technische producttrainingen en in kaart brengen van de opleidingsbehoefte binnen de organisatie

  • Leveren van input voor productcommunicatie, waaronder online communicatie en marketingmateriaal

  • Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

  • Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

  • Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

  • Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

  • Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving

Wat bieden wij

Bij FAAC Technologies werk je in een stabiele, internationaal opererende en technisch gedreven organisatie met een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid.

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.359,45 en € 6.198,54 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring

  • 40 vrije dagen (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen)

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PME, het pensioenfonds voor de Metalektro

  • Een veelzijdige hybride functie op het snijvlak van techniek, commercie en productmanagement

  • De mogelijkheid om bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling en positionering van een internationaal productportfolio

  • Intensieve samenwerking met verschillende disciplines en internationale teams

  • Een professionele werkomgeving met ruimte voor eigen initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling

Over FAAC Technologie

FAAC Technologies, onderdeel van de wereldwijd opererende FAAC Group, is dé specialist in toegangsautomatisering. Van automatische deuren en poorten tot slagbomen en parkeersystemen – wij leveren innovatieve en veilige oplossingen. Bij FAAC werk je in een informele, technische en dynamische omgeving waar samenwerking en klantgerichtheid centraal staan.

De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen, met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units. Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.


Wie ben jij

  • HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, technische of bedrijfskundige richting.

  • Aan het begin van de carrière, met de ambitie om verder te groeien binnen productmanagement.

  • Een starter of circa 1 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring, bijvoorbeeld in productmanagement, productmarketing, sales of een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Affiniteit met technische producten en commerciële vraagstukken.

  • Analytisch sterk en in staat om marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften te doorgronden.

  • Leergierig, initiatiefrijk en bereid om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om met verschillende interne en externe stakeholders samen te werken.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat breng je mee

  • Een analytische en nieuwsgierige instelling.

  • Goede organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden.

  • Interesse in markt- en prijsanalyses en productpositionering.

  • Het vermogen om informatie te vertalen naar concrete inzichten en acties.

  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en gestructureerde werkhouding.

  • Oog voor detail en een goed gevoel voor kwaliteit.

  • Het vermogen om technische informatie begrijpelijk te maken voor commerciële en niet-technische collega's.

  • Affiniteit met internationale samenwerking.

Solliciteren

Zie jij jezelf als Junior Product Manager bij FAAC Technologies en wil je bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling en positionering van onze producten binnen een internationale organisatie?

Solliciteer dan via de bekende weg of neem contact met ons op voor meer informatie. We maken graag kennis met je.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
The challenge
An entrepreneur chasing an unpaid invoice in Lagos. A shop owner confirming a shipment in Guangzhou. A consultant navigating a bank's phone menu in London. For a growing share of Talk360's 6 million+ users, a call is how they get paid, keep a client or close a deal.

These business customers choose us because we're cheaper than carrier and roaming rates, reach mobile, landline and company numbers, need no contract, and use one balance for every country. Today we serve them with a consumer app. Tomorrow we want to be the obvious way small businesses call the world.

jobs.title: Account Executive Tender (Non-profit) & RFPs
jobs.description:
In de non-profit-, overheid- en onderwijswereld draait alles om impact en vertrouwen. Het proces is gestructureerd en verloopt stap voor stap, maar tenders zijn complex en relaties zijn cruciaal. Zo'n 30% van onze commerciële inflow komt binnen via tenders en RFPs — en dat aandeel groeit. RFPs komen daarbij vaak van grotere enterprise-klanten en worden in samenwerking met andere Account Executives voorbereid en opgepakt.

Veel salesmensen begrijpen dat proces onvoldoende. Ze sturen standaardproposities en hopen op het beste. Wij geloven dat het anders moet: met echte gesprekken, diep begrip van aanbestedingsdynamiek en een adviseur die meedenkt in het PvE-proces in plaats van alleen reageert op een uitvraag.

Je bouwt een sterke pijplijn van tenders en RFPs bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten, onderwijsinstellingen en enterprise-accounts. Je wint aanbestedingen en zorgt dat Studytube vanaf de marktconsultatie al als thought leader op de radar staat.

  • Het vroegtijdig spotten van marktconsultaties (ism het Tenderteam) en het actief meedenken in het PvE-proces, zodat criteria aansluiten bij wat wij goed kunnen leveren.

  • RFPs bij grotere enterprise-klanten samen met andere Account Executives voorbereiden en oppakken, zodat expertise en capaciteit gebundeld worden.

  • Het zorgvuldig managen van het contractproces na gunning, inclusief afstemming met legal over voorwaarden, aansprakelijkheid en SLA's.

  • Het opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met opleidingsmanagers, inkopers en directieleden bij non-profitorganisaties, gemeenten en onderwijsinstellingen.

  • Het samenwerken met sales team, tenderteam, implementatieteam, contentteam en customer success team om klanten écht succesvol te maken.

What the job looks like

Geen strak jaarplan, maar een dynamische agenda die meebeweegt met de tenderkalender. De ene week werk je aan een marktconsultatie, de volgende week schrijf je aan een inschrijving, ondersteun je een collega-AE bij een enterprise-RFP, of onderhandel je over een contract.

Who you are

We zoeken geen standaard salesprofiel. We zoeken iemand die tenders en RFPs als vakgebied ziet, niet als bijzaak.

Wat wél belangrijk is:

What you'll do

  • Align client metrics with the shared definitions in our central data foundation, so customers and internal teams see the same numbers.

Your team

You join the Client Reporting team, where client reporting is your full-time focus. The team includes a Product Manager, a dedicated QA engineer and another analytics engineer.

You work closely with the Product department, Customer Success and our central data team, so client reporting fits the product and answers what our customers need.


Who you are

You have 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics engineering or BI development, or grew into it from analysis or data engineering. You think in models and definitions before dashboards. You know that a number a customer sees has to be explainable, consistent and correct. If a client or a CS colleague cannot understand or trust a report, the work is not done.

Must-haves

jobs.title: Campaign Lead, Brand
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for a senior brand campaign leader who can set the vision for our biggest moments, turn ambiguous business goals into breakthrough campaign strategy, and rally a lean, cross-functional team to deliver work that's both culturally relevant and commercially effective.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Lead, Brand owns the strategy, orchestration, and performance of Notion's largest integrated brand campaigns—the tentpole moments that tell the most important stories about who we are, what we make, and why it matters. You'll be the connective tissue across launches and campaigns, making sure every global brand moment brings a cohesive, inspiring narrative to market across channels, audiences, and regions.

Reporting to the Head of Brand & Integrated Marketing, you'll set the brand campaign roadmap, lead campaigns end-to-end from first brief to performance readout, and raise the bar for how the team plans, builds, and learns. You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Creative, Comms, Growth Marketing, and Regional Marketing leads, and help develop other campaign managers on the team. Responsibilities include:

 - Define and own the annual brand campaign roadmap, aligning tentpole moments to company priorities, product launches, and business goals

 - Lead Notion's largest cross-functional tentpole campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement, making high-stakes calls on concept, channel mix, and trade-offs

 - Partner with in-house Creative to originate and champion bold, category-defining brand concepts, and know when to push an idea further versus when to ship it

 - Partner with Product Marketing and Comms to unify product and brand narratives into a single, compelling story for each moment

 - Own campaign budgets and agency/vendor relationships, and partner with Growth Marketing on integrated brand and performance media from planning through reporting

 - Build the measurement framework for brand campaigns with Analytics and Growth, connecting awareness and consideration to pipeline and business outcomes

 - Collaborate with regional teams and localization to adapt and scale campaigns across EMEA, APAC, and other key markets

 - Evolve the campaign operating system—briefs, tiering, workback plans, retros, and AI-powered workflows—so the whole team moves faster with more clarity

 - Represent brand campaigns with marketing leadership and executives, presenting strategy, progress, and results with a clear point of view




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with a track record of leading large-scale, multi-channel brand campaigns that moved the business

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable—and you can sell them up and across the org

 - Strategic owner: You turn ambiguous goals into a clear campaign strategy and roadmap, and you're comfortable owning outcomes, budget, and trade-offs end to end

 - Hybrid brand + performance thinker: You care about craft and tone, and you think rigorously about metrics, media, and sales enablement. You're not a purist in any one discipline

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with AI tools and agents, and you have a perspective on the balance of human vs. AI in creative generation

 - Speed: You bias toward action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - Leader without the title: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you. You influence senior stakeholders, navigate conflicting feedback, and level up the people around you

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to run multiple complex workstreams at once while iterating for improvement

jobs.title: Tegevusjuhendaja
jobs.description:

Tööülesanded: Oled hooliv, vastutustundlik ning hindad meeskonnatööd ja arengut? Siis on see ametikoht Sulle! Sinu töö eesmärgiks on arendada ja säilitada psüühilise erivajadusega inimeste elukvaliteeti. Selleks tuleb igapäevaselt kliendiga koos või tema jaoks teha erinevaid tegevusi: - iseseisvalt elamiseks vajalike oskuste õpetamine; - tööalane nõustamine; - vajadusel arsti külastamine; - juhendamine kodu korrashoiul ja toitumisel; - suhtlemine kliendi lähedastega; - dokumentide haldamine; - vaba aja sisustamise motiveerimine või juhendamine; - võrgustiku- ja meeskonnatöö korraldamine. Kliendiga tehtud töö tuleb dokumenteerida ning see võtab umbes pool tööajast. Töö nõuab tahtmist ja võimekust ringi liikuda - korterite külastused, arstil, tööandja juures käimised jms. Teenusel olevatele inimestele väljasõitude ja ühisürituste korraldamine ja nendel osalemine. Tööle asudes tuleb arvestada, et osa väljaõppest toimub Tartus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meil on hooliv ja kokkuhoidev kollektiiv - jagame ühiselt nii muresid kui rõõme. Elvas on kokkuhoidev kollektiiv. Kord kuus toimuvad asutuse töökoosolekud Tartus. Uutele töötajatele toimuvad uue töötaja koolitused, kus kõik erialaga seotud teemad detailselt läbi käime. Lisaks on olemas mentori ja kvaliteedijuhi tugi. Võid kindel olla, et see ametikoht arendab Sind. Töö pakub võimalust tunda end vajaliku ja olulisena. Tööalaste väljakutsetega toimetulekuks toimuvad regulaarsed kovisioonid ja supervisioonid. Pakume puhkust suveperioodil ja tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi jõulude ajal ning tasustatud vaba päeva võimalust. Toimuvad ühised väljasõidud õppimise- ja kogemuste saamise eesmärgil. Sul on töö tegemiseks oma kindel töökoht, arvuti ja töö telefoniga. Juhul kui erialane haridus puudub, on võimalik see omandada tööl käimise ajal.

Muud nõuded: Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus. Sul peab olema valmisolek tööks puuetega inimestega - võimekus toime tulla pingelistes olukordades, kus on vaja rahu säilitada. Väga oluline on iseenda tundmine, võimekus hoida oma vaimset tervist korras. Samuti on vaja osata oma tööd ja tööaega planeerida. Töö eeldab võimekust töötada nii individuaalselt kui meeskonnas. Parimad tulemused tulevad oskusest ja julgusest küsimusi küsida. Kasuks tuleb hea huumorimeel.

jobs.title: Lasteaiaõpetaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Lasteaiaõpetaja loob turvalise ja arendava õpi- ning kasvukeskkonna, planeerib ja viib läbi õppe- ja kasvatustegevusi ning toetab lapse arengut koostöös lapsevanemate ja tugispetsialistidega. Ootame oma meeskonda lasteaiaõpetajat, kes soovib kujundada lapse arenguteed ning luua inspireerivat õpi- ja kasvukeskkonda. Sinu roll meie juures: . lood turvalise, loova ja õppimist toetava keskkonna . toetad lapse üld- ja õpioskuste arengut (mäng, keel, suhtlemine, eneseregulatsioon) · planeerid ja viid läbi õppe- ja kasvatustegevusi, lahtudes lapse arengust · märkad iga lapse eripära ja kohandad õpet vastavalt vajadustele · toetad lapse iseseisvust, õpimotivatsiooni ja enesekindlust · teed koostööd lapsevanemate ja tugispetsialistidega . annad lapse arengust sisulist ja toetavat tagasisidet · panustad meeskonnatöösse ja lasteaia arengusse

Omalt poolt pakume: Tähendusrikast tööd, kus iga päev loebToetavat ja inspireerivat meeskonda Võimalust kasvada koos laste ja kolleegidega Kaasaegset ja arenevat töökeskkonda Koolitusi ja enesetäiendamise võimalusi

Muud nõuded: Ootame Sind, kui Sa: omad kõrgharidust ja õpetaja kutset või kõrgharidust ja pedagoogilisi kompetentse. Valdad eesti keelt vähemalt C1 tasemel või on eesti keel Sinu emakeel. Oled koostööaldis, avatud ja professionaalne. Väärtustad lapse arengut ja individuaalsust. Oled valmis õppima, katsetama ja arenema. Lood positiivse ja toetava õhkkonna.

jobs.title: Eripedagoog

Tööülesanded: Ootame oma meeskonda hoolivat, loovat ja uuendusmeelset eripedagoogi, kes märkab iga lapse tugevusi, toetab tema individuaalset arengut ning panustab koostöös kolleegidega kaasava ja inspireeriva õpikeskkonna loomisse. Sinu roll meie juures on toetada iga lapse individuaalset arengut ja õppimist, märgata tema tugevusi ja arengulisi erivajadusi ning leida sobivaid võimalusi lapse arengu toetamiseks koostöös perede ja lasteaia meeskonnaga. Sinu peamised tööülesanded: Laste arengu, õpioskuste ja toe vajaduse hindamine. Individuaalsete ja väikerühma eripedagoogiliste tegevuste kavandamine ja läbiviimine. Laste tunnetusprotsesside, eneseregulatsiooni, suhtlemis- ja sotsiaalsete oskuste arengu toetamine. Õpetajate, abiõpetajate ja lapsevanemate nõustamine. Koostöö tugispetsialistide ja lasteaia meeskonnaga sobivate tugimeetmete kavandamisel ja rakendamisel. Osalemine laste individuaalsete arengukavade koostamisel, rakendamisel ja hindamisel. Lapse vajadustest lähtuva õpikeskkonna ja õppetegevuste kohandamine. Tugimeetmete tulemuslikkuse hindamine ja tööalase dokumentatsiooni koostamine.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tähendusrikast tööd, kus iga päev loebToetavat ja inspireerivat meeskonda Võimalust kasvada koos laste ja kolleegidega Kaasaegset ja arenevat töökeskkonda Koolitusi ja enesetäiendamise võimalusi

jobs.description: Suksivuokraamon työntekijöitä – Peuramaa Ski, Kirkkonummi**Tykkäätkö vauhdista, talvesta ja ihmisten kanssa työskentelystä? ABOUT THE ROLE

Connectors let Replit’s agents and applications securely access the tools and data people already use. Behind every connection are hard systems problems: whose identity is being used, what they’re allowed to access, how credentials stay valid, and how those guarantees hold across services and execution environments.



We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Software Engineer with deep experience in authentication, authorization, security, and distributed systems to own this foundation. You’ll build and operate the infrastructure that makes connections work reliably across Replit’s projects, agent conversations, and environment builds.



This is a hands-on engineering role, not a security advisory position or a job focused on adding individual integrations. You’ll trace behavior across service boundaries, make architectural decisions, ship production changes, and simplify an evolving platform. Success means connections are secure and reliable end to end, and the team can confidently build on the systems you own.



YOU WILL

 - Own authentication and authorization across the connection lifecycle. Design how users, agents, applications, and services establish identity, receive access, and act on behalf of others.

 - Build reliable credential infrastructure. Handle OAuth flows, token refresh, revocation, reauthorization, and secure credential storage, including concurrency and partial failures.

 - Make connections work across the platform. Follow requests through application services, credential proxies, agent execution, and environment builds, preserving security guarantees at every boundary.

 - Design and operate distributed systems. Improve service-to-service communication, tenant isolation, failure recovery, and observability across shared and isolated deployments.

 - Handle provider-specific constraints without compromising the platform. Account for differences such as user versus bot credentials, token limits, and source-control authentication.

 - Lead safe migrations and reduce technical debt. Replace fragile or duplicated paths with clearer ownership and simpler designs while keeping existing customer workflows working.

 - Raise the team’s technical judgment. Explain system behavior clearly, lead design discussions, mentor engineers, and partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Fix a token-refresh race that causes connections to fail when multiple services use them concurrently.

 - Trace an authorization failure from an agent request through the credential proxy to the provider, then address the underlying design problem.

 - Design a connection lifecycle that behaves consistently across projects, conversations, and environment builds.

 - Migrate customers to a stronger identity and authorization model without disrupting their applications.

 - Remove legacy connection paths and add end-to-end tests that make future changes safer.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - Deep hands-on experience with authentication and authorization systems, including OAuth 2.0, access scopes, credential lifecycles, and trust boundaries.

 - Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, consistency, retries, idempotency, and partial failure.

 - Experience designing, shipping, and operating production backend infrastructure with meaningful security and reliability requirements.

 - Ability to understand an unfamiliar system end to end and debug failures across multiple services and third-party APIs.

 - A track record of owning complex changes through design, implementation, rollout, and production validation.

 - Pragmatic engineering judgment: you improve existing systems incrementally, reduce unnecessary complexity, and know when a provider-specific exception is justified.

 - Clear technical communication and a willingness to help other engineers develop deeper systems understanding.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with service identity, delegated access, token federation, or credential-management infrastructure.

 - Experience with multi-tenant isolation, enterprise governance, or customer-managed cloud deployments.

 - Experience migrating authentication or authorization systems while preserving existing customer access.

 - Experience leading cross-team architectural work and mentoring engineers.



BONUS POINTS

 - Familiarity with emerging cross-app access standards such as Cross-App Access (XAA), as well as OAuth 2.0 token exchange, OpenID Connect, and identity federation.

 - Experience designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or connector-authoring tools.

 - Familiarity with AI agent tool execution or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

 - Experience supporting integrations with complex authentication behavior, including collaboration tools and source-control providers.




LOCATION

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Legal Engineering Counsel
jobs.description:
We're building a new healthcare clearinghouse

Stedi is the only headless clearinghouse and RCM engine. Headless means every part of our product is accessible via API. Developers and AI agents build their own interface on top of it. By offering modern, AI-ready APIs alongside traditional real-time and batch EDI processes, we enable both healthcare technology businesses and established players to exchange mission-critical transactions. Our clearinghouse product and customer-first approach have set us apart. Stedi was ranked by Ramp as one of the fastest-growing SaaS vendors.

Stedi has lightning in a bottle: engineers and designers shipping products week in and week out; a lean business team supporting the company's infrastructure; a passion for automation and eliminating toil; and $142 million in funding from top investors like Stripe, Addition, USV, Bloomberg Beta, First Round Capital, and more.

To see what we ship, watch the 2026 Stedi Keynote. To learn more about how we work, watch our founder Zack's interview with First Round Capital.

What weâre looking for

Stedi is hiring a Legal Engineering Counsel to build how our legal work gets done, and to own a large share of it. Every new customer, payer connection, and partnership runs through a contract, and the volume grows every month. Youâll design the systems that handle it (playbooks, review workflows, automation, and AI tooling) and run them on live deals with counterparties ranging from fast-moving healthtech startups to national payers.

This role pairs legal practice with technical skill. You bring strong legal training and a feel for how commercial deals work, and youâve used AI and other technology to make legal work faster and more consistent. What you learn on live deals shapes the systems, and better systems make the next deal faster.

Youâll join a small, effective Legal team with a broad mandate. We keep up with a fast-growing, highly regulated business by investing in good systems and tools, and this role sits at the center of that investment. Healthcare experience is not required â we value strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn a new industry quickly. If you have the talent and drive to help build a world-class legal function alongside Stediâs experienced legal counsel mentors at a rapidly scaling tech company, we want to talk.

What youâll do

  • Build and own the systems behind Stediâs contracting, including playbooks, clause libraries, templates, intake and approval workflows, and AI-assisted first-pass review.

  • Break recurring legal work into repeatable steps with clear inputs, decision points, and escalation paths, then decide what to automate, what to standardize, and what needs a lawyer.

  • Turn our legal counselâs nuanced advice, negotiation positions, and fallbacks into structured guidance that people and AI tools can apply consistently.

  • Test and measure what you build. Check outputs against real deals, track where the tools fall short, and iterate until they hold up.

  • Draft and negotiate contracts yourself using those systems â including customer agreements, BAAs, NDAs, payer trading partner agreements â from first redline through signature.

  • Structure our contract data so the team (and our tools) can answer questions about our agreements in minutes.

  • Partner with Sales and Account Management. Build self-serve paths for routine agreements and field the questions that still need a person.

  • Take on new areas based on interest and business need as Stedi and the Legal team grow.

Who you are

  • Youâre bar-admitted and want to practice law while building the systems that support it.

  • BigLaw or in-house experience, ideally on transactional work, is a strong plus.

  • Youâve built with technology, whether thatâs AI workflows, prompts and evaluations, automations, scripts, or no-code tools, and you can show what you made.

  • Youâre comfortable working with structured data and technical tools, and you pick up new ones quickly. Coding experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Previous experience monitoring automated systems, AI agents, or other complex digital workflows

  • Familiarity with APIs, automation tools, or basic scripting

  • Experience working in shift-based operations or providing support across multiple time zones

Benefits

  • Fully remote — work from anywhere

  • Hourly freelance contract with scheduled shifts

  • Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge AI operations project involving autonomous systems

You’ll define the problem, propose a direction, split the work into pieces that each ship something useful, and build them with the team, supporting our most critical workloads.Your Tasks:Take a goal like “improve authentication”, talk to the people it affects, and write a design that breaks it into milestones.Lay out the tradeoffs (reliability, cost, effort, risk) and bring the team and stakeholders to an agreement.Write production code, mostly in Go, from service interfaces and data models to the messaging between services, and take your design through review to launch.Estimate throughput, storage and latency before you build, then load test and failure test the result.Work out how state is partitioned, replicated and cached, so a bad node degrades one region while the rest of the cluster keeps running.Explain your designs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, review other people’s work, and mentor.Your Profile:You push clean, tested code in at least one language, such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, C++, C# or TypeScript. We write mostly in Go and expect you to pick it up quickly if you don’t know it.You break large, ambiguous problems into smaller ones and work through them systematically.You can design a system end to end, with realistic estimates for each component, and explain the tradeoffs.You know data structures and complexity, concurrency, how data stores behave as they grow, and why networks and services fail.You’ve led a project from a fuzzy idea to a shipped result, delivering in increments.You use excellent written and spoken communication skills to communicate and influence technical choices clearly, tailoring trade-offs for each audience.You measure what you build and use the data to choose what comes next.You may lean toward software design or toward how systems fit together, but a blend of both is the perfect sweet spot.Nice to have:Prior hands-on experience with distributed systems patterns: RPC, pub/sub, message queues, event streaming, replication, partitioning.Prior experience running services on AWS, Azure or Kubernetes.Prior exposure to tracing, metrics and structured logging (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus or similar).Philosophical inclinations towards infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or similar).Prior experience with enough UNIX and networking (TCP/IP, load balancing) to debug your own systems.A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.What We Can Offer You:The inspiring opportunity of working on the award winning MMO EVE Online in cooperation with amazingly talented and passionate co-workers.A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.Double work station setup and flexible work environment.A lively fun division that hosts regular events.An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.Home internet.A conditional monthly transportation grant.Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.Relocation Package.Please submit your application in English: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/5d2d81e1-174f-4d78-b0cb-ff3a6bd24b4eApplication deadline: Deceember 31st, 2026

jobs.title: Driller
jobs.description: Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. Currently, we are seeking skilled assistant driller to join our team for a long-term geothermal drilling projects.Position Overview:As a driller, you will be responsible for operating and supervising the drilling operations on the rig. You will ensure that all drilling activities are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company standards and regulations. jobs.title: Technical Director
jobs.description: CCP Games is seeking a Technical Director to lead the technical direction of Core Technology and CARBON — CCP's shared game development platform spanning engine runtime, rendering, graphics, tools, pipelines, and developer experience. In this role, you will set the technical direction for CARBON, ensuring it evolves as a high-leverage, modern platform that creates meaningful value for game teams across CCP. The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. You will directly manage technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, maintaining visibility into the health and opportunities across the department while keeping teams aligned on a coherent engineering direction.This is a hands-on leadership role. You will contribute through architecture, technical guidance, and code review, while focusing primarily on raising the effectiveness and goals of the engineers and leaders around you.The position is located in Reykjavík, Iceland.Your Tasks:Define and drive the technical direction for CARBON across runtime, graphics, rendering, tools, pipelines, and shared developer technology.Collaborate closely with the Senior Development Director of Core Technology to translate product vision and priorities into clear technical strategy and execution.Lead and develop technical leaders across Graphics, Runtime, and Tools, strengthening quality, alignment, and team growth.Provide architectural guidance across CARBON, ensuring great decisions around performance, scalability, maintainability, and developer experience.Guide the department in adopting AI-assisted development in practical, high-value ways that improve speed, iteration, and engineering effectiveness.Shape CARBON's open-source direction to increase platform leverage, accessibility, and long-term relevance.Communicate technical direction, tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities across the organization. Your Profile:Significant senior technical leadership experience in game development.Deep game engine expertise across runtime systems, rendering or graphics, and developer tooling.Proven ability to define technical direction and align multiple teams around a coherent engineering vision.People leadership experience across senior engineers, technical leads, or engineering managers.Conviction in the value of AI-assisted and open-source development, with the judgment to apply both strategically and practically.A pragmatic, growth-oriented leadership style with a bias toward learning, experimentation, and solution-finding within real-world constraints.Experienced enough as an engineer to lead with credibility through technical judgment, architecture, and code review.Excellent communication skills, able to convey complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.Please apply on our website: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/d2a51a4a-7510-400a-b141-e3883b9e02bdLast application date is Desember 31st, 2026

jobs.title: DEKO søger en CNC-operatør
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med CNC-bearbejdning og lyst til at arbejde med moderne produktion? Vil du være en del af en virksomhed, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og udvikling er i fokus?

DEKO søger en CNC-operatør, der skal arbejde med programmering, opsætning og drift af moderne 5-aksede CNC-maskiner i en højteknologisk produktion.

Om jobbet

Som CNC-operatør hos DEKO bliver du en del af et stærkt produktionsteam, hvor du arbejder med avanceret bearbejdning af aluminiumprofiler til blandt andet karme og døre. Du får en alsidig hverdag med moderne produktionsudstyr, varierende opgaver og mulighed for løbende faglig udvikling.

Dine opgaver:

  • Programmering og opsætning af 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Drift og overvågning af produktionen med fokus på kvalitet og præcision

  • Visuel kvalitetskontrol af emner

  • Optimering og vedligeholdelse af produktionsprocesser

  • Sikring af levering i den rette kvalitet og til aftalt tid

  • Samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af produktionen

  • Deltagelse i en rotationsordning mellem flere arbejdsstationer

Din profil:

  • Du har erfaring som CNC-operatør – evt. uddannet industritekniker

  • Du har gerne erfaring med 3- eller 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Du kan læse tekniske tegninger og arbejde præcist efter mål

  • Du har en god teknisk forståelse og sans for kvalitet

  • Du er fortrolig med IT som en naturlig del af produktionen

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring i produkter, maskiner og arbejdsprocesser

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Sociale aktiviteter og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår i en virksomhed med fokus på kvalitet og udvikling

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

Hvis du er klar til at blive en del af DEKO og bidrage med din erfaring inden for CNC-bearbejdning, så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til ja@deko.dk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, hvor du vil få mange flere informationer og detaljer om stillingen. Ansættelsen sker ligeledes løbende.

Om DEKO

DEKO er en familieejet virksomhed, hvor det familiære og høj performance går hånd i hånd. Her er kort vej fra idé til handling, og nye initiativer bliver mødt med nysgerrighed frem for bureaukrati. Vi tror på, at udvikling kræver mod til at prøve nye ting, og at man lærer mere af at forsøge end af at lade være.

Vi har i mere end 50 år udviklet produkter til indvendigt byggeri og er i dag en af Skandinaviens førende leverandører af glasvægge samt en af Danmarks største tømrer- og snedkervirksomheder inden for indretning af kontor-, erhvervs- og institutionsbyggeri

jobs.title: Handyman til lettere håndværksopgaver – København og Nordsjælland
jobs.description:

Vi søger en handyman, der kan klare de mange mindre håndværksopgaver hos vores kunder. Måske er du tidligere håndværker og har lyst til at bruge din erfaring på en ny måde, i en hverdag hvor to dage sjældent er ens. For os er det ikke nødvendigvis dit CV, der afgør det. Det gør din tilgang til arbejdet, dit engagement og din faglige stolthed.

Typiske opgaver:

  • Almindelige viceværtopgaver

  • Skifte en vandhane og andet ikke-autorisationskrævende arbejde

  • Rense stoppede afløb

  • Tilslutte hårde hvidevarer

  • Justere og reparere døre, skuffer og køkkenlåger

  • Andre lettere reparationer og småopgaver

Vi tilbyder:

  • 37 timer om ugen, mandag til fredag kl. 7–15. Er du den rette, er vi også åbne for at tale om et andet timetal

  • Arbejdsbil, du kan tage med hjem

  • Varierede opgaver og frihed under ansvar

  • Gode arbejdsforhold

  • Et godt kollegaskab, hvor ordentlighed og humor vægtes højt

  • En plads i en voksende virksomhed, der værdsætter sine medarbejdere og belønner dem, der gør en ekstra indsats

Du er:

  • Praktisk anlagt og god med værktøj

  • God til at arbejde selvstændigt og løse problemer på stedet

  • Opmærksom på detaljen

  • Venlig og serviceminded over for kunderne

  • En, der sætter en ære i at levere et godt resultat

  • I besiddelse af kørekort (kategori B)

En fordel, men ikke et krav:

  • Baggrund som håndværker

  • Du taler dansk eller engelsk

Vi er en 70 år gammel familieejet virksomhed med over 70 medarbejdere. I dag ledes virksomheden af 3. generation.

Ansøgere, der bliver inviteret til samtale, gøres opmærksomme på, at en eventuel ansættelse kræver, at der fremvises straffeattest.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV via https://www.damsgaard.dk/job/

jobs.title: Driftsleder/Supervisor til produktionen i Birkerød
jobs.description:
Der søges på vegne af vores samarbjedspartner i Birkerød (ENGLISH VERSION BELOW)

Vi er en dansk scale-up i Nordsjælland, der udvikler, producerer og sælger hampbaserede produkter. Vi arbejder med hele processen fra råvare til færdigt produkt og står overfor at udvide med egne produktionsfaciliteter, så vi kan lancere nye produktkategorier og skalere produktionen.Hverdagen er præget af høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed, dokumentation og stabile processer.

Om rollen

Vi søger en supervisor, der kan få den daglige drift i produktionen til at hænge sammen. Du skal skabe overblik på gulvet, følge op på opgaverne og være med til at sikre, at produktionen kører som den skal.

Det er en hands-on rolle, hvor du både deltager i arbejdet og har ansvar for den daglige koordinering i produktionen. Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet under Operationschefen og får en central rolle i at holde flow, kvalitet og fremdrift i hverdagen.

Personaleansvar er ikke et krav, men du skal have erfaring med arbejdsledelse eller daglig supervision i en produktionsvirksomhed.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Sikre den daglige koordinering og arbejdsfordeling i produktionen

  • Følge op på, at opgaver bliver løst korrekt og til tiden

  • Holde overblik over flowet på linjerne og reagere hurtigt ved stop, afvigelser eller flaskehalse

  • Deltage aktivt i produktionen, herunder betjening og overvågning af produktions- og fillingsprocedurer

  • Sikre hygiejne, sporbarhed og dokumentation på batch-niveau

  • Udføre og følge op på in-process-kontroller samt sikre, at kvalitetsdata er opdateret i de digitale systemer

  • Bidrage til orden, rengøring, first-level vedligehold på linjerne

  • Samarbejde tæt med lager og logistik om råvareflow og færdigvareafhentning

  • Være med til at forbedre arbejdsgange og skabe mere struktur i takt med, at produktionen udvikler sig

Din profil

  • Du har erfaring fra fødevare-, kosmetik-, pharma- eller anden procesindustri

  • Du har erfaring med arbejdsledelse, koordinering eller daglig supervision i en produktion

  • Du er vant til at arbejde struktureret og holde overblik i en travl hverdag

  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, renlighed og det at følge procedurer

  • Du kan læse og skrive dansk og/eller engelsk

  • Du er tryg ved at arbejde i digitale systemer og kan lære nye processer og værktøjer

  • Du tager ansvar, når noget skal løses, og bidrager naturligt til, at hverdagen fungerer

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i den daglige drift af produktionen

  • Fast daghold med mulighed for fleks efter aftale

  • Grundig oplæring, inkl. træning i vores principper

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn samt frokostordning, pensionsordning og arbejdsgiverbetalt sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for at vokse i takt med, at vi skalerer nye linjer og automatiserer processer

Ansøgning

Send CV og kort motiveret ansøgning til job@chc.dk snarest og senest d. 27. november 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Har du spørgsmål, så ring til 71 99 19 55 eller skriv til km@chc.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Production Supervisor – Hands-on Role

Location: Birkerød, North Zealand, Denmark

Recruitment on behalf of our partner company in Birkerød.

We are a Danish scale-up based in North Zealand, developing, manufacturing and selling hemp-based products. We manage the entire process, from raw materials to finished products, and are preparing to expand our operations with our own production facilities. This will allow us to introduce new product categories and increase production capacity.

Our daily operations require high standards of quality, traceability, documentation and process consistency.

About the Role

We are looking for a Production Supervisor who can help keep our daily production operations running smoothly. You will coordinate work on the production floor, follow up on tasks and help ensure that production runs efficiently and according to plan.

This is a hands-on position, combining active participation in production with responsibility for day-to-day coordination and supervision.

You will work as part of the team reporting to the Head of Operations and play an important role in maintaining production flow, quality and progress.

Formal line management or personnel responsibility is not required, but you must have experience supervising, coordinating or leading daily work in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily production activities and allocate tasks across the production team.

  • Follow up to ensure tasks are completed correctly and on schedule.

  • Monitor production flow and respond quickly to interruptions, deviations and bottlenecks.

  • Participate directly in production, including operating and monitoring production equipment and filling processes.

  • Ensure hygiene, traceability and batch-level documentation.

  • Perform and follow up on in-process quality checks, ensuring that quality data is accurately recorded in our digital systems.

  • Maintain good housekeeping, cleaning routines and first-level equipment maintenance on the production floor.

  • Work closely with warehouse and logistics colleagues to coordinate raw material supply and the movement of finished goods.

  • Help improve workflows and establish more structured processes as production expands.

Your Profile

  • You have experience in food manufacturing, cosmetics, supplements, pharmaceuticals or another process-based manufacturing industry.

  • You have previous experience with production-floor supervision, work coordination or day-to-day production leadership.

  • You work in a structured manner and can maintain an overview in a busy production environment.

  • You understand the importance of quality, cleanliness and following established procedures.

  • You can read and write in Danish and/or English.

  • You are comfortable using digital systems and willing to learn new processes and tools.

  • You take responsibility, solve problems when they arise and actively contribute to keeping daily operations running smoothly.

What We Offer

  • An important role in the daily operation and development of our production facilities.

  • Fixed daytime working hours, with flexibility by agreement.

  • Thorough onboarding and training, including training in our operational principles and procedures.

  • Competitive salary, a company lunch scheme, an employer pension scheme and employer-paid private health insurance.

  • Opportunities to develop professionally as we expand production lines and introduce further automation.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to job@chc.dk as soon as possible and no later than the 27th of November 2026.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please call +45 71 99 19 55 or email km@chc.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Myyntiedustaja (kodinturvaratkaisut)
jobs.description: **Haluatko myyntityön, jossa päiväsi eivät kulu kylmäsoittoihin tai asiakkaiden perässä juoksemiseen? Etsimme nyt myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijoita rooliin, jossa tärkein tehtäväsi on auttaa asiakkaita suojaamaan kotinsa ja yrityksensä Verisuren palveluilla.****Jos nautit tavoitteellisesta myynnistä, kaupan syntymisen tunteesta sekä asiakaskohtaamisista,rooli on juuri sinua varten.**Myynti ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijanamme et lähde liikkeelle tyhjästä. Jokaiselle päivällesi rakennetaan valmiiksi laadukkaita myyntimahdollisuuksia sovittujen asiakastapaamisten, nykyasiakaskäyntien sekä huoltojen ja asennusten kautta. Tavoitteena on yksinkertaisesti luoda mahdollisimman paljon onnistuneita kohtaamisia ja kauppoja.Tarjoamme sinulle 1500 € kuukausittaisen pohjapalkan, kannustavan palkkiomallin sekä Suomen tunnetuimman ja luotetuimman turvapalvelun myytäväksesi. Kun vahva brändi, toimiva konsepti ja jatkuva asiakasvirta yhdistyy, sinulle syntyy erinomaiset mahdollisuudet vaikuttaa omalla tekemiselläsi ansiotasoosi.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- **Varma pohjapalkka & motivoivat komissiot:** Tarjoamme sinulle **jatkuvan pohjapalkan 1500€/kk** sekä kannustavat ja motivoivat komissiot: uusista hankituista asiakkaista saat keskimäärin n. **300-400€ myyntikomission.** - **Lämpimät asiakaskohtaamiset:** Varmistamme sinulle riittävästi monipuolisia myynniin mahdollisuuksia niin valmiiksi sovittujen asiakastapaamisten kuin nykyasiakkailla tapahtuvien käyntien muodossa. - **Perehdytyksen, jota on hiottu yli 30 vuoden ajan:** Olemme kehittäneet koulutustamme sekä perehdytystämme pitkään, joten saat käyttöösi vinkit, neuvot ja tuen, joiden avulla onnistumisesi on vain sinusta itsestäsi kiinni. - **Autoetu:** Saat käyttöösi auton, jolla ajat niin työ- kuin vapaa-ajallasi. - **Eteneminen**: Kaikki myynnin esihenkilömme ovat aloittaneet myyjinä. Saat konkreettisen mahdollisuuden rakentaa uraasi eteenpäin. Sales Manager Naneten tarinaan pääse tutustumaan urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura). - **Best Place to Work sertifioidun organisaation.** Sijoituimme Suomen keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa parhaimpien joukkoon. Katso urasivujemme blogiosiosta (www.verisure.fi/ura) myyjiemme kokemuksia Verisurella työskentelemisestä. **Mitä päiväsi myynti- ja turvaratkaisujen asiantuntijana tarkemmin pitää sisällään?**Tyypillinen työpäiväsi alkaa esimerkiksi klo 10:00 tapaamisella, jossa asiakas odottaa sinua luoksensa. Onnistut tapaamisella vakuuttamaan hänet palvelusta, ja pääset sopimaan järjestelmän asennuksen heti huomiselle. Jatkat tästä päivääsi toisen asiakkaasi luokse, jossa suoritat hänen järjestelmänsä huollon. Järjestelmän huollon yhteydessä tarjoat parasta mahdollista palvelua ja selvität, onko asiakkaalla muita suojaamista kaipaavia kohteita, tai mahdollisesti tuttuja, joille hän haluaisi palvelua suositella.Päiväsi jatkuu mökkikohteella, jonne toteutat asennuksen, jonka olit sopinut viime viikolla turvattuasi ensin asiakkaan kotikohteen. Asennusten ja huoltojen yhteydessä kontaktoit myös lähialueen talot kartoittaaksesi uusia mahdollisia asiakkaita.Viikkosi koostuu monipuolisesti erilaisista kohtaamisista niin uusien kuin nykyisten asiakkaiden kanssa, sisältäen tapaamisia, asennuksia, huoltoja ja lähialueen suoraa asiakaskontaktointia. Tärkein tehtäväsi on siis toteuttaa mahdollisimman monen uuden kodin ja yritystilan suojaaminen Verisuren palvelulla.**Työaikasi on pääsääntöisesti ma–pe klo 10:00–18:00.** Työ on aktiivista kenttätyötä, joten tiimipalavereja ja koulutuksia lukuun ottamatta toimit pääsääntöisesti kentällä asiakkaidesi luona.**Voisiko tämä olla sinun seuraava uramahdollisuus?**Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää vahvaa motivaatiota tavoitteellista myyntityötä kohtaan sekä erinomaisia vuorovaikutustaitoja. Aiemmat näytöt suoramyynnin parista katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ne eivät ole välttämättömyys. Työssä tehtävät asennukset ja huollot eivät vaadi aiempaa kokemusta, sillä koulutamme sinut niihin.**Tehtävässä edellytämme sinulta:**- Ajokorttia: Tarvitset B-kortin (manuaali) ja täysikäisyyttä. - Sujuvia vuorovaikutustaitoja suomen kielellä. - Pystyt työskentelemään joustavasti arkisin 10:00-18:00 välillä. - Tausta: Edellytämme on nuhteetonta rikostaustaa (edellytys turvasuojaajakortille). **Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**Jos uusi myyntiroolimme sytytti kiinnostukseksi, klikkaa linkkiä, jätä CV sekä yhteystietosi, jonka jälkeen olemme sinuun yhteydessä. Paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fiKatso tulevien kollegoidesi ajatuksia urasivuiltamme ja lisätiedot sosiaalisesti mediasta Instagramista & TikTokista @verisurelaiset.

jobs.title: FPGA Engineer Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As an FPGA Engineer Intern on Harmattan AI’s compute module team, you will take camera aggregation from concept to real hardware for the first time. Our drones carry more cameras than a single processor can take in, and your job is to show how an FPGA can close that gap. You will own the work end to end, from first design to a demonstrator on the bench. Your results will set how cameras are connected in our next hardware generation.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate existing IP cores, write HDL wrappers, simulate and validate FPGA logic that merges multiple camera streams into one.

  • Investigate the system’s limits in camera count, resolution and frame rate.

  • Build the processor-side pipeline that splits the merged stream so each camera stays independently usable.

  • Debug the full chain, from cables and connectors to FPGA logic and camera software on the processor.

  • Deliver a complete demonstrator and documentation that guide our next hardware design.

Candidate Requirements

  • Final-year Master’s or engineering school student in electrical engineering, electronics or embedded systems.

  • Previous hands-on experience with FPGAs and digital board design and debugging.

  • Experience writing software that runs close to the hardware; embedded Linux is a plus.

  • Ideally, previous exposure to video or camera interfaces.

  • Hands-on in the lab and comfortable reworking wiring, connectors and test setups to get a system running.

  • Curious, autonomous and persistent when hardware refuses to behave.

  • Full commitment to Harmattan AI’s mission, with the drive to go the extra mile.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

jobs.title: Kahvilatyöntekijä, Relove Freda, Helsinki
jobs.description: Nyt on loistava mahdollisuus päästä osaksi Reloven Fredalla sijaitsevan kahvilan tiimiä! Etsimme uutta osa-aikaista kahvilatyöntekijää Punavuoren uniikkiin ympäristöön.Relove on kotimainen, arvoihin nojaava perheyritys, joka yhdistää vastuullisen muodin, laadukkaat kahvilatuotteet ja sydämellisen asiakaspalvelun ainutlaatuiseksi kokonaisuudeksi. Me tarjoamme makuelämyksiä sesongin raaka-aineista ja ennen kaikkea kohtaamisia, jotka jäävät mieleen.Kahvilatyöntekijänä olet tärkeässä roolissa luomassa asiakkaille mukavia kahvilahetkiä. Huomioithan, että meillä työskennellään kahvilan puolella ajoittain myös yksin.Jotta solahtaisit Reloven monipuoliseen kahvilatoimintaan, edellytetään sinulta useamman vuoden kokemusta kahvila- ja/tai ravintolatyöskentelystä, erinomaisia asiakaspalvelutaitoja, myyntihenkisyyttä sekä kykyä toimia kiireisessä ympäristössä. Mikäli sinulta löytyy aiempaa kokemusta erikoiskahvien valmistuksesta, kerrothan myös tästä hakemuksessasi.Vastapainoa työn hektisyydelle tuovat työn parhaat puolet - ihanat asiakkaat, lämmin ja kannustava työilmapiiri ja sydämelliset kollegat. Reloven konseptia kehitetään jatkuvasti ja tehtävässä on mahdollista päästä oikeasti tuomaan esille omaa näkemystä ja visioita. Työsuhde-etuina saat käyttöösi ePassi-edut, kattavan työterveyshuollon, alennusta kahvilatuotteista sekä omasta vaatteiden myyntijaksosta Relovessa.Työsuhteen tiedot:- Työsuhdemuoto:Vakituinen ja osa-aikainen (60h/3vko)- Työajat: Maanantaista sunnuntaihin klo 07-20 välillä- Palkka:MaRaVa-tes:n mukainen 13,70-15,04€/h kokemuksesi mukaan- Aloitus:Joustavasti mahdollisimman pianTyö edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä sekä hygienia- ja anniskelupassia. Työssä tarvitset sujuvan suomen kielen lisäksi myös englannin kielen taitoa. Lisäksi terveydentilan selvitys salmonellatartunnasta vaaditaan ennen töiden aloitusta.Mikäli jaat arvomme vastuullisuudesta, edelläkävijyydestä sekä lempeydestä, hae mukaan joukkoomme. Koska kierrättäminen on kaunista.Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Barona toimii rekrytoinnin yhteistyökumppanina. Valitut henkilöt solmivat työsuhteet Reloven kanssa.HUOM! Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia.Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication• Networks• Antennas• Control systems• Sound• Artifical intelligence• Signal Processing• Computing• Quantum technology • Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.• participating in grant application activities• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirementsApplicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
